q: Which branch of chemistry deals with fertilizers, catalysts, pigments and coatings?
Inorganic chemistry deals with fertilizers, catalysts, pigments and coatings.
Supercritical fluids are highly ____ states of matter.
Supercritical fluids are highly compressed states which show properties of both gases and liquids.
Which of the following is a heterogeneous mixture?
A solution of calcium hydroxide in water
A solution of salt in water
A solution of potassium nitrate in water
Concrete is a heterogeneous mixture; solutions are homogeneous (Exercise 1(vi)).
Which of these is studied in Organic chemistry?
separating and identifying the components of a material
the hazardous effects of shopping bags
the abundance of atoms and molecules in the universe
Organic chemistry deals with hydrocarbons and their derivatives.
Which statement about a heterogeneous mixture is correct?
A heterogeneous mixture has different concentrations of its constituents in different parts, for example a sample of rock.
A heterogeneous mixture is a pure substance containing the same kind of atoms.
A heterogeneous mixture has properties that are always different from those of the elements it is formed from.
A heterogeneous mixture can be broken into its constituent elements by a chemical reaction.
A heterogeneous mixture has different concentrations of its constituents in different parts, for example a sample of rock. (Section 1.5)
What happens to extra sugar added to a saturated sugar solution?
It floats on top and vanishes
It settles at the bottom of the beaker
Any more sugar added at the saturation stage settles down at the bottom of the beaker.
Which of these is studied in Biochemistry?
the rate of hydrolysis of starch at different temperatures
the chemical composition of Earth and its minerals
the vital processes occurring in living organisms
finding the concentration of the components present in a sample
Biochemistry deals with the vital processes occurring in living organisms.
The solubility of which of these in water decreases with the increase in temperature?
Li₂CO₃, CaCrO₄ and Ca(OH)₂ are less soluble at higher temperature.
Which four states of matter are observed in everyday life?
Solid, gas, plasma and liquid crystal
Solid, liquid, gas and supercritical fluid
The text names solid, liquid, gas and plasma.
Which type of matter is a pure substance containing the same kind of atoms?
An element is a pure substance containing the same kind of atoms. (Section 1.5)
What is the chemical formula of Potassium nitrate?
The formula of Potassium nitrate is KNO₃.
How many branches of chemistry are described in the chapter?
The chapter describes 11 branches: physical, inorganic, organic, environmental, analytical, bio-, nuclear, polymer, geo-, medicinal and astrochemistry.
Which of these is an element?
Which statement about Ozone (O₃) is correct?
Ozone (O₃) has a giant macromolecular structure.
Ozone (O₃) is an allotropic form of oxygen with the formula O₃.
Ozone (O₃) consists of spheres of carbon atoms arranged in pentagons and hexagons.
Ozone (O₃) is an allotropic form of oxygen with the formula O₃. (Section 1.4)
How does the solubility of Calcium hydroxide in water change as the temperature rises?
It first increases and then decreases
The solubility of Calcium hydroxide in water decreases with temperature.
Which of these is studied in Nuclear chemistry?
geochemical mapping used in forestry and environmental monitoring
the reactions taking place inside the nucleus of an atom
Nuclear chemistry deals with the reactions taking place inside the nucleus of an atom.
Which form of matter is a highly compressed state that shows properties of both gases and liquids?
A supercritical fluid is a highly compressed state that shows properties of both gases and liquids. (Section 1.2)
Which of these statements about Physical chemistry is NOT correct?
Physical chemistry explains how fundamental physical laws make atoms and molecules show specific characteristics.
Physical chemistry explains life through chemical processes.
Physical chemistry investigates how substances behave at atomic and molecular levels.
Physical chemistry is used to predict and change the rates of reactions and so optimize industrial conditions.
That statement is false. Physical chemistry investigates how substances behave at atomic and molecular levels. (Section 1.1)
Which of these statements about Inorganic chemistry is NOT correct?
Inorganic chemistry deals with substances used as fertilizers, medicines, catalysts, pigments and coatings.
Inorganic chemistry studies metals, non-metals, salts, acids and bases.
Inorganic chemistry deals with radioactivity and the transformation of atomic nuclei.
Inorganic chemistry studies the synthesis, composition, properties and structure of elements and compounds that contain little or no carbon.
That statement is false. Inorganic chemistry studies metals, non-metals, salts, acids and bases. (Section 1.1)
Which branch of chemistry deals with radioactivity?
Which statement about a compound is correct?
A compound has its elements joined by chemical bonds that are not easy to break.
A compound has components that are not chemically bound and can be separated by physical methods.
A compound is formed when more than one type of element or compound is mixed together in any ratio.
A compound is represented by a symbol when it exists in the form of atoms, for example Na or Ca.
A compound has its elements joined by chemical bonds that are not easy to break. (Section 1.5)
Which compound exists as a network arrangement of its atoms?
HCl, NH₃ and H₂O exist as molecules; ionic NaCl and covalent sand (SiO₂) exist as network arrangements.
What is the chemical formula of Argon?
The formula of Argon is Ar.
What is the chemical formula of Calcium chromate?
The formula of Calcium chromate is CaCrO₄.
Which of these statements about Biochemistry is NOT correct?
Biochemistry studies metals, non-metals, salts, acids and bases.
Biochemistry explains life through chemical processes.
Biochemistry studies the chemical substances and vital processes occurring in living organisms.
Biochemistry gives insights into the structure and function of proteins, carbohydrates, lipids and nucleic acids.
That statement is false. Biochemistry explains life through chemical processes. (Section 1.1)
Rocks are composed of different types of minerals such as ____.
Rocks are heterogeneous mixtures composed of minerals such as granite, mica and limestone.
Which of these statements about a colloidal solution is NOT correct?
A colloidal solution has particles a little bigger than those of a true solution but too small to be seen with the naked eye.
A colloidal solution includes starch solution and the white of an egg.
A colloidal solution has particles that settle down on standing and are left as a residue on filter paper.
A colloidal solution has particles that do not settle down on standing yet pass through filter paper.
That statement is false. A colloidal solution has particles a little bigger than those of a true solution but too small to be seen with the naked eye. (Section 1.6)
Which form of matter is composed of particles with very high kinetic energy?
Plasma is composed of particles with very high kinetic energy. (Section 1.2)
Which statement about Buckminster fullerene (C₆₀) is correct?
Buckminster fullerene (C₆₀) is soft, has a low melting point and cannot conduct electricity.
Buckminster fullerene (C₆₀) has a giant macromolecular structure.
Buckminster fullerene (C₆₀) has a layered structure of hexagonal rings of carbon.
Buckminster fullerene (C₆₀) is an allotropic form of oxygen with the formula O₃.
Buckminster fullerene (C₆₀) is soft, has a low melting point and cannot conduct electricity. (Section 1.4)
Which process makes use of the increase in solubility with temperature to obtain a pure solid as crystals?
Dissolving in hot water and cooling gives crystals of the pure solid, as with potassium nitrate.
What is the chemical formula of Buckminster fullerene?
The formula of Buckminster fullerene is C₆₀.
How does the solubility of gases in water change with an increase in temperature?
The solubility of gases in water decreases with the increase in temperature.
A sample of rock is a heterogeneous mixture because ____.
the concentration of its constituents is different in different parts
In a heterogeneous mixture the concentration of constituents differs in different parts.
Which of these is studied in Physical chemistry?
the rate of hydrolysis of starch at different temperatures
the structure and function of proteins and nucleic acids
the hazardous effects of shopping bags
Physical chemistry deals with the rate of hydrolysis of starch at different temperatures.
Which compound does NOT show an appreciable increase in solubility in water with the increase in temperature?
The solubility of NaCl in water does not increase appreciably with temperature.
Which substance has the formula O₂?
O₂ is the formula of Oxygen gas.
Which of these is an allotropic form of carbon?
Diamond is an allotrope of carbon.
Graphite is an allotropic form of which element?
Graphite is an allotrope of carbon.
Which carbon-based material is a two-dimensional crystal?
Graphene is a two-dimensional crystal, a single layer of carbon atoms arranged in a hexagonal pattern.
In what ratio by weight are hydrogen and oxygen present in water?
In water, hydrogen and oxygen are present in a fixed ratio of 1 : 8 by weight.
Plasma can be considered a partially ____ gas containing electrons, ions and photons.
Plasma is a partially ionized gas containing electrons, ions, photons, etc.
Which of these is a property of a colloidal solution?
Particles slightly bigger than in a true solution
A colloidal solution: Particles slightly bigger than in a true solution.
Which allotropic form has molecules that are not charged, have no boundaries and have no unpaired electrons?
Buckminster fullerene (C₆₀) has molecules that are not charged, have no boundaries and have no unpaired electrons. (Section 1.4)
Which statement about Nuclear chemistry is correct?
Nuclear chemistry studies large molecules made by linking together a series of building blocks.
Nuclear chemistry studies the structure, formation, properties, composition and reactions of carbon-containing compounds.
Nuclear chemistry deals with carbon compounds (hydrocarbons and their derivatives).
Nuclear chemistry deals with the reactions taking place in the nucleus of an atom.
Nuclear chemistry deals with the reactions taking place in the nucleus of an atom. (Section 1.1)
Which of these is a colloidal solution?
Slaked lime used for white wash
Starch solution is a colloidal solution.
Which substance has the formula SiO₂?
SiO₂ is the formula of Sand (silicon dioxide).
Graphene is an allotropic form of which element?
Graphene is an allotrope of carbon.
According to the book, why is the solubility of table sugar in water far greater than that of sodium chloride at 20 °C?
Salt ions are larger than sugar molecules, so more water molecules surround one ion
Sugar molecules are larger than salt ions, so more water molecules can surround one sugar molecule
Sugar molecules are larger than salt ions, so more water molecules can surround a single sugar molecule, causing it to dissolve in larger amounts.
Which statement about a colloidal solution is correct?
A colloidal solution includes starch solution and the white of an egg.
A colloidal solution has solute particles that do not dissolve in the solvent and can be seen.
A colloidal solution has particles that settle down on standing and are left as a residue on filter paper.
A colloidal solution is formed when sodium chloride or copper sulphate dissolves in water.
A colloidal solution includes starch solution and the white of an egg. (Section 1.6)
Which form of matter makes possible reactions that cannot be carried out in conventional solvents, for example in supercritical carbon dioxide?
A supercritical fluid makes possible reactions that cannot be carried out in conventional solvents, for example in supercritical carbon dioxide. (Section 1.2)
In a true solution the solute particles are completely ____ in the solvent.
A true solution has solute particles completely homogenized in the solvent.
Which branch of chemistry explains life through chemical processes?
Biochemistry explains life through chemical processes. (Section 1.1)
Which form of matter has a definite shape and a fixed volume?
A solid has a definite shape and a fixed volume. (Section 1.2)
Rhombic sulphur is an allotropic form of which element?
Rhombic sulphur is an allotrope of sulphur.
Which statement about Organic chemistry is correct?
Organic chemistry studies the abundance and reactions of atoms, molecules and ions in the universe and their interaction with radiation.
Organic chemistry studies molecules and ions occurring in space and interstellar space.
Organic chemistry deals with carbon compounds (hydrocarbons and their derivatives).
Organic chemistry helps in understanding the causes, effects and solutions of different types of pollution.
Organic chemistry deals with carbon compounds (hydrocarbons and their derivatives). (Section 1.1)
Which statement about Monoclinic sulphur is correct?
Monoclinic sulphur consists of spheres of carbon atoms arranged in pentagons and hexagons.
Monoclinic sulphur is an allotropic form of oxygen with the formula O₃.
Monoclinic sulphur has a layered structure of hexagonal rings of carbon.
Monoclinic sulphur is the less stable of the two crystalline allotropic forms of sulphur.
Monoclinic sulphur is the less stable of the two crystalline allotropic forms of sulphur. (Section 1.4)
Which type of matter is represented by a symbol when it exists in the form of atoms, for example Na or Ca?
An element is represented by a symbol when it exists in the form of atoms, for example Na or Ca. (Section 1.5)
Which of these is a property of a mixture?
Hydrogen and oxygen in water are in the ratio 1 : 8 by weight
Properties differ from those of its elements
A mixture: Components keep their own properties.
Which branch of chemistry deals with the properties and structure of polymers?
Polymer chemistry deals with the properties and structure of polymers.
Which branch of chemistry deals with the rate of hydrolysis of starch at different temperatures?
Physical chemistry deals with the rate of hydrolysis of starch at different temperatures.
Which allotropic form is the less stable of the two crystalline allotropic forms of sulphur?
Monoclinic sulphur is the less stable of the two crystalline allotropic forms of sulphur. (Section 1.4)
What is the chemical formula of Hydrogen chloride?
The formula of Hydrogen chloride is HCl.
Which statement about a liquid crystal is correct?
A liquid crystal is a tough, flexible and light material.
A liquid crystal is a partially ionized gas containing electrons, ions and photons.
A liquid crystal has properties between those of conventional liquids and crystalline solids.
A liquid crystal is a state of matter that is not commonly encountered, such as dark matter, Bose–Einstein condensate, nuclear matter or quantum spin liquid.
A liquid crystal has properties between those of conventional liquids and crystalline solids. (Section 1.2)
Which substances are the most dense?
In crystalline solids particles are perfectly arranged and strongly bonded; they are the most dense substances.
Which of these statements about a compound is NOT correct?
A compound is formed when more than one type of element or compound is mixed together in any ratio.
A compound can be broken into its constituent elements by a chemical reaction.
A compound has properties that are always different from those of the elements it is formed from.
A compound has its elements joined by chemical bonds that are not easy to break.
That statement is false. A compound has its elements joined by chemical bonds that are not easy to break. (Section 1.5)
Which substance has the formula CaCrO₄?
CaCrO₄ is the formula of Calcium chromate.
Which form of matter has particles that oscillate about their mean positions?
A solid has particles that oscillate about their mean positions. (Section 1.2)
Which substance has the formula O₃?
O₃ is the formula of Ozone.
How does the solubility of Calcium chromate in water change as the temperature rises?
It first increases and then decreases
The solubility of Calcium chromate in water decreases with temperature.
What is the chemical formula of Water?
The formula of Water is H₂O.
Which branch of chemistry deals with the abundance of atoms and molecules in the universe?
Astrochemistry deals with the abundance of atoms and molecules in the universe.
Which substance does not show an appreciable increase in solubility in water with the increase in temperature?
Sodium chloride (NaCl) does not show an appreciable increase in solubility in water with the increase in temperature. (Section 1.8)
Which of these is a property of a solid?
Molecules closely attached but moving randomly
A solid: Needs no container for storage.
Which form of matter is relatively incompressible and rigid?
A solid is relatively incompressible and rigid. (Section 1.2)
Which of these is a true solution?
In a true solution solute particles are completely homogenized in the solvent, e.g. sodium chloride or copper sulphate in water.
Which of the following is an intermediate state of matter?
Intermediate states lie where liquid meets gas or liquid meets solid, e.g. supercritical fluids, liquid crystals and graphene.
Which of these is a property of a liquid?
Found in lightning and welding arcs
A solution of salt in water is a homogeneous mixture because its concentration is ____ throughout.
A salt solution has a uniform concentration throughout, so it is homogeneous.
Small atoms that never join together
Gases found in the upper atmosphere
Large molecules made by linking together a series of building blocks
Pure substances containing one kind of atom
Polymers are large molecules made by linking together a series of building blocks.
Which statement about a supercritical fluid is correct?
A supercritical fluid has particles that oscillate about their mean positions.
A supercritical fluid has a definite shape and a fixed volume.
A supercritical fluid exists in fluorescent tubes, lightning and welding arcs.
A supercritical fluid is a highly compressed state that shows properties of both gases and liquids.
A supercritical fluid is a highly compressed state that shows properties of both gases and liquids. (Section 1.2)
Which branch of chemistry studies metals, non-metals, salts, acids and bases?
Inorganic chemistry studies metals, non-metals, salts, acids and bases. (Section 1.1)
Which branch of chemistry deals with the hazardous effects of shopping bags?
Environmental chemistry deals with the hazardous effects of shopping bags.
Which substance has the formula AgNO₃?
AgNO₃ is the formula of Silver nitrate.
Which of these statements about a liquid is NOT correct?
A liquid has a density higher than that of a gas.
A liquid has molecules that are closely attached but moving randomly.
A liquid has significant intermolecular forces between its molecules.
A liquid exists in fluorescent tubes, lightning and welding arcs.
That statement is false. A liquid has significant intermolecular forces between its molecules. (Section 1.2)
Which form of matter has molecules that are very widely apart with no order whatsoever?
A gas has molecules that are very widely apart with no order whatsoever. (Section 1.2)
In which state does matter exist in the Sun?
Most matter of the universe, including the Sun, is in the plasma state (Exercise 2(vi)).
The atoms of Buckminster fullerene are arranged in which shapes?
C₆₀ consists of spheres made of atoms arranged in pentagons and hexagons.
Which of these is a naturally occurring polymer?
Proteins, cellulose and nucleic acids are naturally occurring polymers.
Which branch of chemistry deals with the use of nuclear processes in agriculture and medicine?
Nuclear chemistry deals with the use of nuclear processes in agriculture and medicine.
Oxygen (O₂) and ozone (O₃) are ____ of the element oxygen.
Oxygen exists in two allotropic forms: oxygen (O₂) and ozone (O₃).
Which statement about an element is correct?
An element has components that keep their own identity and specific properties.
An element can be broken into its constituent elements by a chemical reaction.
An element is represented by a symbol when it exists in the form of atoms, for example Na or Ca.
An element has different concentrations of its constituents in different parts, for example a sample of rock.
An element is represented by a symbol when it exists in the form of atoms, for example Na or Ca. (Section 1.5)
Which branch of chemistry deals with the effects that humans have on the environment through the release of chemicals?
Environmental chemistry deals with the effects that humans have on the environment through the release of chemicals.
Which substance has the formula Cl₂?
Cl₂ is the formula of Chlorine gas.
The crystals of which substance have a rhombic shape?
Sulphur exists as rhombic and monoclinic crystals (Exercise 1(iv)).
Which statement about Biochemistry is correct?
Biochemistry investigates how substances behave at atomic and molecular levels.
Biochemistry studies the chemical composition of Earth and its sources and minerals.
Biochemistry studies the chemical substances and vital processes occurring in living organisms.
Biochemistry is used to predict and change the rates of reactions and so optimize industrial conditions.
Biochemistry studies the chemical substances and vital processes occurring in living organisms. (Section 1.1)
Which allotropic form has a giant macromolecular structure?
Diamond has a giant macromolecular structure. (Section 1.4)
Which of these is studied in Medicinal chemistry?
the absorption and metabolism of a drug in the human body
finding the concentration of the components present in a sample
the reactions taking place inside the nucleus of an atom
Medicinal chemistry deals with the absorption and metabolism of a drug in the human body.
Physical and chemical changes may be brought about by what?
Changing the name of the substance
Both physical and chemical changes may be brought about by absorption or evolution of energy.
Which branch of chemistry deals with carbon compounds (hydrocarbons and their derivatives)?
Organic chemistry deals with carbon compounds (hydrocarbons and their derivatives). (Section 1.1)
Which form of matter exists in fluorescent tubes, lightning and welding arcs?
Plasma exists in fluorescent tubes, lightning and welding arcs. (Section 1.2)
How does the solubility of Potassium nitrate in water change as the temperature rises?
It first increases and then decreases
The solubility of Potassium nitrate in water increases with temperature.
A solution in which the maximum amount of solute has been dissolved at a particular temperature is called a ____ solution.
A saturated solution has the maximum amount of solute dissolved in a particular amount of solvent at a particular temperature.
Which of these is studied in Astrochemistry?
the use of nuclear processes in agriculture and medicine
finding the concentration of the components present in a sample
molecules and ions in interstellar space
the absorption of wavelength measured with an ultraviolet spectrometer
Astrochemistry deals with molecules and ions in interstellar space.
Which of these statements about a true solution is NOT correct?
A true solution is formed when sodium chloride or copper sulphate dissolves in water.
A true solution has solute particles that cannot be seen and leaves no residue on filter paper.
A true solution has solute particles that are completely homogenized in the solvent.
A true solution includes starch solution and the white of an egg.
That statement is false. A true solution has solute particles that cannot be seen and leaves no residue on filter paper. (Section 1.6)
Which branch of chemistry explains how fundamental physical laws make atoms and molecules show specific characteristics?
Physical chemistry explains how fundamental physical laws make atoms and molecules show specific characteristics. (Section 1.1)
Which of these is a property of an element?
Components can be separated by physical methods
Contains the same kind of atoms
An element: Contains the same kind of atoms.
Which branch of chemistry helps in understanding the causes, effects and solutions of different types of pollution?
Environmental chemistry helps in understanding the causes, effects and solutions of different types of pollution. (Section 1.1)
Monoclinic sulphur is an allotropic form of which element?
Monoclinic sulphur is an allotrope of sulphur.
Noble gases such as helium and argon exist as mono-atomic molecules.
Which allotropic form has a layered structure of hexagonal rings of carbon?
Graphite has a layered structure of hexagonal rings of carbon. (Section 1.4)
Which of these is a compound?
Matter is present in neon signs in the state of ____.
Plasma exists in fluorescent tubes, lightning and welding arcs; neon signs also contain plasma (Exercise 1(i)).
Graphene is a single layer of ____ atoms arranged in a hexagonal pattern.
Graphene is a single layer of carbon atoms arranged in a hexagonal pattern.
Which of these gaseous elements exists as independent molecules?
Gaseous elements such as N₂, O₂ and Cl₂ exist as independent molecules; noble gases are mono-atomic.
Which of these is a property of a true solution?
Particles slightly bigger than in a true solution
A true solution: Particles cannot be seen.
Which substance has the formula KClO₃?
KClO₃ is the formula of Potassium chlorate.
Which substance has the formula Ca(OH)₂?
Ca(OH)₂ is the formula of Calcium hydroxide.
Which statement about Medicinal chemistry is correct?
Medicinal chemistry does not cover simple carbon salts such as carbonates, bicarbonates, oxides and carbides.
Medicinal chemistry designs and synthesizes medicines or drugs that are beneficial for mankind.
Medicinal chemistry is used to predict and change the rates of reactions and so optimize industrial conditions.
Medicinal chemistry deals with the separation, identification and determination of the concentration of the components of a material.
Medicinal chemistry designs and synthesizes medicines or drugs that are beneficial for mankind. (Section 1.1)
Which statement about a mixture is correct?
A mixture can be broken into its constituent elements by a chemical reaction.
A mixture has its elements joined by chemical bonds that are not easy to break.
A mixture is formed when more than one type of element or compound is mixed together in any ratio.
A mixture is a pure substance made up of two or more different elements combined in a fixed ratio.
A mixture is formed when more than one type of element or compound is mixed together in any ratio. (Section 1.5)
In the sugar activity, 5 g of sugar is added at a time to 100 g of water. A solution which can still dissolve more sugar is called ____.
A solution which can dissolve more solute at a particular temperature is called an unsaturated solution.
What is the chemical formula of Potassium chlorate?
The formula of Potassium chlorate is KClO₃.
How does the solubility of sugar in water change as the temperature rises?
It first increases and then decreases
The solubility of sugar in water increases with temperature.
Which branch of chemistry deals with geochemical mapping used in forestry and environmental monitoring?
Geochemistry deals with geochemical mapping used in forestry and environmental monitoring.
How many crystalline allotropic forms of sulphur are mentioned in the chapter?
Sulphur exists in two crystalline allotropic forms, rhombic and monoclinic.
Which substance has the formula He?
He is the formula of Helium.
Which form of matter has a very low density?
A gas has a very low density. (Section 1.2)
What is the chemical formula of Ozone?
The formula of Ozone is O₃.
What is the chemical formula of Chlorine gas?
The formula of Chlorine gas is Cl₂.
Which form of matter is the only state of matter that needs no container for storage?
A solid is the only state of matter that needs no container for storage. (Section 1.2)
Which substance has a solubility in water that increases with the increase in temperature?
Potassium chloride (KCl) has a solubility in water that increases with the increase in temperature. (Section 1.8)
Which statement about a true solution is correct?
A true solution is shown by a mixture of chalk in water.
A true solution includes starch solution and the white of an egg.
A true solution is formed when sodium chloride or copper sulphate dissolves in water.
A true solution has particles a little bigger than those of a true solution but too small to be seen with the naked eye.
A true solution is formed when sodium chloride or copper sulphate dissolves in water. (Section 1.6)
Which substance has the formula HCl?
HCl is the formula of Hydrogen chloride.
The states of solid, liquid and gas differ mainly because of the strength of intermolecular forces, the arrangement of particles and the ____ between the particles.
The three states differ in strength of intermolecular forces, arrangement of particles and distance between them.
Which branch of chemistry studies the synthesis, composition, properties and structure of elements and compounds that contain little or no carbon?
Inorganic chemistry studies the synthesis, composition, properties and structure of elements and compounds that contain little or no carbon. (Section 1.1)
Which of these statements about a solid is NOT correct?
A solid has a definite shape and a fixed volume.
A solid is the only state of matter that needs no container for storage.
A solid makes possible reactions that cannot be carried out in conventional solvents, for example in supercritical carbon dioxide.
A solid has particles that oscillate about their mean positions.
That statement is false. A solid has a definite shape and a fixed volume. (Section 1.2)
Which branch of chemistry focuses on the properties, structure and synthesis of polymers and macromolecules?
Polymer chemistry focuses on the properties, structure and synthesis of polymers and macromolecules. (Section 1.1)
Which branch of chemistry deals with the reactions taking place inside the nucleus of an atom?
Nuclear chemistry deals with the reactions taking place inside the nucleus of an atom.
Buckminster fullerene is an allotropic form of which element?
Buckminster fullerene is an allotrope of carbon.
Which substance has the formula CuSO₄?
CuSO₄ is the formula of Copper sulphate.
Which of these statements about a suspension is NOT correct?
A suspension has solute particles that do not dissolve in the solvent and can be seen.
A suspension is shown by a mixture of chalk in water.
A suspension has particles that settle down on standing and are left as a residue on filter paper.
A suspension is formed when sodium chloride or copper sulphate dissolves in water.
That statement is false. A suspension has solute particles that do not dissolve in the solvent and can be seen. (Section 1.6)
Which of these is studied in Analytical chemistry?
finding the concentration of the components present in a sample
the reactions taking place inside the nucleus of an atom
the design and synthesis of a new drug
Analytical chemistry deals with finding the concentration of the components present in a sample.
In the solubility curves of Fig (1.6), which of these shows almost no rise in solubility with temperature?
The NaCl curve is almost flat; KNO₃ rises steeply.
What happens to the solute particles of a true solution when it is filtered?
They are collected as a residue
They pass through the pores of the filter paper, leaving no residue
True solution particles pass through filter paper and leave no residue.
Which form of matter is a partially ionized gas containing electrons, ions and photons?
Plasma is a partially ionized gas containing electrons, ions and photons. (Section 1.2)
Which form of matter has a density higher than that of a gas?
A liquid has a density higher than that of a gas. (Section 1.2)
Which branch of chemistry deals with the absorption of wavelength measured with an ultraviolet spectrometer?
Analytical chemistry deals with the absorption of wavelength measured with an ultraviolet spectrometer.
Which allotropic form has a cage-like structure?
Buckminster fullerene (C₆₀) has a cage-like structure. (Section 1.4)
Which form of matter is a tough, flexible and light material?
Graphene is a tough, flexible and light material. (Section 1.2)
How does the solubility of Carbon dioxide gas in water change as the temperature rises?
It first increases and then decreases
The solubility of Carbon dioxide gas in water decreases with temperature.
Which branch of chemistry deals with the separation, identification and determination of the concentration of the components of a material?
Analytical chemistry deals with the separation, identification and determination of the concentration of the components of a material. (Section 1.1)
Which generally happens to the solubility of solids in water when the temperature increases?
It usually increases, but this is not a general rule
Usually solubility increases with temperature but it cannot be taken as a general rule.
Which substance has the formula Ca?
Ca is the formula of Calcium.
Which statement about Plasma is correct?
Plasma is a partially ionized gas containing electrons, ions and photons.
Plasma has a definite shape and a fixed volume.
Plasma has significant intermolecular forces between its molecules.
Plasma is a tough, flexible and light material.
Plasma is a partially ionized gas containing electrons, ions and photons. (Section 1.2)
Which of these is studied in Polymer chemistry?
the absorption and metabolism of a drug in the human body
the synthesis of macromolecules built from small building blocks
the design and synthesis of a new drug
the chemical composition of Earth and its minerals
Polymer chemistry deals with the synthesis of macromolecules built from small building blocks.
Diamond is an allotropic form of which element?
Diamond is an allotrope of carbon.
Which branch of chemistry designs and synthesizes medicines or drugs that are beneficial for mankind?
Medicinal chemistry designs and synthesizes medicines or drugs that are beneficial for mankind. (Section 1.1)
Which branch of chemistry studies the sources, reactions, effects and fates of chemical species in the air, soil and water?
Environmental chemistry studies the sources, reactions, effects and fates of chemical species in the air, soil and water. (Section 1.1)
Which branch of chemistry deals with the reactions of carbon-containing compounds?
Organic chemistry deals with the reactions of carbon-containing compounds.
Which of these is studied in Geochemistry?
the digestion of food in the human body
molecules and ions in interstellar space
geochemical mapping used in forestry and environmental monitoring
the synthesis of macromolecules built from small building blocks
Geochemistry deals with geochemical mapping used in forestry and environmental monitoring.
States of matter that are not commonly encountered are called ____ states.
States that are not commonly encountered are called exotic states of matter.
What is the chemical formula of Calcium hydroxide?
The formula of Calcium hydroxide is Ca(OH)₂.
